component.name: SSH Manager
component.summary: Tabbed SSH terminal and SFTP file manager for Linux

description.p: SSH Manager is a native MobaXterm alternative for Linux that combines independent SSH terminal tabs with FileZilla-style dual-pane SFTP file management.
Save servers, use passwords, SSH keys or an agent, connect through jump hosts, transfer folders, and manage local and remote files from one app.
Fixes New SSH Tab and New SFTP Tab so they save and validate the current server form before connecting.
Adds detailed SFTP transfer progress, faster parallel small-file batches, and combined local/remote refresh.
Fixes password SSH authentication and improves authentication error messages.
Adds independent SSH and SFTP tabs, local file editing, complete context menus, explicit SFTP host-key trust, and an offline runtime package.
